summary: - **[key4hep/k4FWCore#459](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/459)** — OverlayTiming selects background SimCalorimeterHits relative to time of flight, consistent with signal and tracker hits, and adds ApplyTimeOfFlight; calorimeter TimeWindows tuned to the old behaviour may need revisiting.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#685](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/685)** — ALLEGRO and IDEA world volumes shrink from 25 m half-length cubes to the outermost detector extent plus 50 cm, preventing particles curling back through the return field.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#690](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/690)** — IDEA parallel-world tracking volume becomes vacuum and disconnected, removing material overlaps that affected simulation and reconstruction, and the tracking volume is added to IDEA_o2_v01.

- **[key4hep/KKMCee#2](https://github.com/key4hep/KKMCee/pull/2)** — KKMCee switches to direct Gaussian mapping for the beam energy spread, activating the upstream energy-spread fix required for the Autumn 2026 FCC-ee generation campaign.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#565](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/565)** — get_V0s_jet and get_SV_jets build each jet's V0s and secondary vertices from its own tracks rather than other jets', changing per-jet vertexing outputs for all analyses using them.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#564](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/564)** — Vertexing fixes on the pre-edm4hep1 branch correct the SV pointing angle and jet-relative SV angles, plus out-of-bounds reads, uninitialised fields and fits with dropped tracks.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#538](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/538)** — fccanalysis submit grid adds DIRAC-backed grid submission with EOS/XRootD or LFN inputs, deterministic job planning, balanced chunking and isolated worker sandboxes via ILCDIRAC (see also **HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#557**).

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#151](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/151)** — ACTS blueprint for CLD (and ILD_FCCee) builds sensor surfaces on the silicon instead of the passive module, restoring endcap hits that were previously all dropped from tracking.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#147](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/147)** — MaterialMappingAlg and ActsGeoSvc switch to ACTS' versioned JSON material format; existing JSON maps must be converted with ActsMaterialMapMigrate or regenerated, and a new CLD map is provided.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/72)** — HepMCFileWriter gains a RootTree output format alongside Ascii, changes its default filename to gen_output.hepmc, and HepMCFileReader auto-detects format to read ROOT-tree files.
